worldcombat.skill.waterpulse.summary: Throws a humming bead of water: on impact the water rings outward in pulses, everyone the rings cross takes an echo hit, and those shaken may be left ringing and confused.
worldcombat.skill.waterpulse.use.0: A straight water-pulse shot at medium range
worldcombat.skill.waterpulse.use.1: Use the spreading rings to catch foes beside the target
worldcombat.skill.waterpulse.use.2: Rattle a target to open a fumble window
worldcombat.skill.waterpulse.description: The bead strikes a non-ally for about %1$s special damage, then %3$s rings spread from the landing spot out to a %2$s block radius, one every %4$s.
Each ring deals about %1$s special echo damage to every foe it has not yet washed over; each foe is hit only once per cast.
On hit, there is a %1$s chance to confuse the target for %2$s. While confused, it moves 12%% slower and has a %3$s chance to fail each move or ordinary attack.
worldcombat.skill.waterpulse.resonant.on: Resonant form: the wave spreads wider and the confusion lasts longer and triggers more often, but the main hit is lighter, the wave slower with wider spacing between rings, range -2 blocks and cooldown +6 ticks.
worldcombat.skill.waterpulse.resonant.of: Point form: a tighter, faster, heavier single hit, at the cost of a narrower radius, a shorter ringing and a lower trigger chance.
worldcombat.skill.waterpulse.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, cooldown %4$s s, costing %5$s PP.
worldcombat.skill.waterpulse.growth.0: From level %1$s the pulse power rises to %2$s and the radius to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.waterpulse.growth.1: From level %1$s the pulse power rises to %2$s, the rings grow to %3$s and the confusion to %4$s.
On: radius x1.25, confusion duration x1.2 and trigger chance +6%%, but main power x0.94, wave speed x0.85, range -2 blocks and cooldown +6 ticks, for covering an area. Off: a tighter, faster, heavier single hit with a narrower radius and a shorter ringing.
Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger prefers opening from farther away.
On: when foes crowd beside the target the user fires first, so the spreading rings catch more; off: order by ordinary ranged attack only.
On: targets already carrying the shared confusion identity rank lower, saving the shot for a clear-minded foe; off: all targets score the same.
